children: (TSX-V: CRD) ("Copper Road" or the "Company") announced today that it has completed its latest option payments under its agreements for the Ben Nevis Project, keeping the agreements in good standing. The Company paid a total of $65,000 in cash and issued 500,000 common shares to the optionors.

“We’re excited to keep the Ben Nevis Project agreements moving forward” said Mark Goodman, Interim President and CEO. “We have made great progress in compiling and digitizing historical data as well as completing the Mobile MT Survey. We continue to work towards a drill program in the coming months and coming to meaningful exploration agreements with local First Nations.”
The shares are subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance and remain subject to final acceptance by the TSX Venture Exchange.

Copper Road Resources Inc. is a Toronto-based mineral exploration company focused on acquiring and exploring base and precious metal properties. The Company’s current focus is the Ben Nevis Volcanic Complex Project in the Kirkland Lake–Larder Lake area of northeastern Ontario, within the Blake River Group of the Abitibi greenstone belt. Through four option agreements, the Company is earning a 100% interest in a consolidated land package at Ben Nevis, which it believes has potential to host gold rich volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) deposits. The Company’s shares trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol CRD.
